title: Bus Passengers Reportedly Injured After Starship Delivery Robot Entered a Crossing Against a Red Light in Tallinn, Estonia
summary: A Starship delivery robot reportedly entered a crossing against a red light in Tallinn, Estonia. A city bus braked sharply and collided with it, causing passengers to fall; the transit operator reported up to nine injuries. Starship said lighting conditions had affected the robot's traffic-light recognition and announced software changes.
